map.330 kWh 用电的两种计费: Two billing methods for 330 kWh usage
map.上次读数 12 450、本次 12 780 → 用电 330 kWh。单一电价: Previous reading 12,450, current 12,780 → usage 330 kWh. Flat rate 0.60 CNY/kWh: 330 × 0.60 = 198.00 CNY. Under tiered pricing (tier 1: 0–200 kWh at 0.55 CNY, excess at 0.65 CNY): 200×0.55 + 130×0.65 = 110.00 + 84.50 = 194.50 CNY. The water and gas meters work the same: subtract the previous reading from the current to get usage, then accumulate by the corresponding unit price or tiers.
map.阶梯电价怎么累计？: How is tiered electricity pricing accumulated?
map.按用量从低到高逐档套用各档单价后求和，而不是全部按最高档单价计。工具按你填的各档: Apply each tier unit price from low to high usage and sum them, rather than pricing all at the highest tier. The tool accumulates tier by tier per the upper limits and prices you enter; please fill in according to the tiers published by your local utility.
